title: N.Y. Lays out Master Plan, Rallies Partners Toward 5-GW Nuclear Goal

meta.summary:
New York’s third nuclear summit laid out the progress Gov. Kathy Hochul’s administration has made since she launched a drive to get 5 GW of nuclear capacity built in the state. 
 The post  N.Y. Lays out Master Plan, Rallies Partners Toward 5-GW Nuclear Goal  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
